changelog: [Never Segment]: added three positionally-specific conditions matching the critic's measured over-segmentation/wrong-boundary cases: (1) never split immediately before a sentence-final trailing fragment that lacks a full predicate (a bare object/noun phrase with no following verb), (2) never carve out a standalone one-word discourse-filler segment — attach it to the clause that follows, (3) when a clause is followed by a reporting/quotative connective such as -했더니/-하니까/-라고 하길래 that introduces the next clause, the boundary belongs BEFORE that connective, not after it, so the connective stays with the clause it introduces rather than being stranded with the clause before it.

[Decision Procedure]: extended step 2's checklist with three matching tests — (f) does B consist only of a trailing verb-less fragment (bare noun/object with no predicate)? (g) is A a single short discourse filler being isolated as its own segment? (h) does the candidate boundary fall right after a reporting/quotative connective that actually introduces B, meaning the tag should instead be placed immediately before that connective? — so the reject/move logic operationalizes the newly added [Never Segment] conditions without banning any connective form outright.
